Job Title: ETL Developer 
 Location: Washington, DC
 Duration: Approximately 6 months+
 
 Must be local face to face required 
 
 Max Hourly Rate: $40-45/hour
 
 Top Skills: SSRS, SSIS, SQL, MySQL, and SQL Server 2012
 

 MUST BE US CITIZEN, GREEN CARD, EAD GC, TN, L2EAD, H4EAD 
 
 
 Job Details : 
 Migrations : 
 ** ETL Mapping - Data is coming from Oracle and SQL Server Database 
 He wants to have someone who he can sit down with and discuss mapping out mass amounts of data from all different Databases and getting the data onto their new platform and then have this person literally map (document) and execute it with him. 
 · As for "DevOps" They deploy their apps both Automated and Manual 
 Nice to Have - not requirements- MySQL and DB@ (however he thinks asking for DB2 is probably too much for this role and pay) 
 Important - MySQL- SQL- SQL Server 
 - Wants someone who is smart, knows what they are doing (doesn't need their hand held)- education is not important to him (having a degree isn't a non negotiable) and they are very casual there in the DC office 
 - 6 month contract with potential to be extended- or go perm- depends on fit, performance and workload at 6 months- also depends on the outcome of the migration 
 -- Where candidates/ vendors are missing- he keeps seeing people with the full stack or a lot of SSRS and reporting- really needs the focus to be on ETL and SQL 
 
 Job Summary: 
 This role acts as subject matter expert on data warehousing and reporting and is responsible to lead the analysis, design, development, implementation and support of the Enterprise Data Warehouse and key reporting deliverables. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of SSRS, SSAS, and dimensional modeling to use this data to create software applications that present data through reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI’s.
